mapper.sql: id, question_key, question, answer, hit_count, enabled, operator, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_annotation_qa (question_key, question, answer, hit_count, enabled, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{questionKey}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{hitCount}, #{enabled}, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_annotation_qa SET question_key = #{questionKey}, question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, enabled = #{enabled}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_annotation_qa WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY hit_count DESC
